title: ChipBlocks block manifest
description: Single source of truth for cross-cutting block metadata. Per ADR-003 (../ADR-003-block-manifest.md), this file is authored at repo root and read by scripts/codegen-frontend.mjs + scripts/codegen-backend.py to produce the registries and tables in 7 hand-written target files. The .tsx and .py per-block files stay hand-written and are referenced by path only — codegen never reads them.

type.description: Type id used as React Flow node.type, BLOCK_REGISTRY key, and BLOCK_PORT_TYPES key. Lowercase, no hyphens or underscores.

label.description: Display name shown in the palette and as the React Flow node title.

description.description: One-line palette tooltip describing what the block does.

color.description: Palette swatch color and App.css .block-<type> border-color. 6-digit hex.

category.description: Palette grouping + BLOCKS.md TOC section. One of the 9 categories enumerated here.

componentPath.description: Path to the hand-written React component. Codegen never reads it; recorded so manifest-integrity tests can confirm the file exists.

backendPath.description: Path to the hand-written Amaranth Elaboratable. Codegen never reads it; recorded so manifest-integrity tests can confirm the file exists.

backendClass.description: Symbol name exported from backendPath. Used by codegen-backend.py to write the `from .module import Class` line in backend/blocks/__init__.py.

dir.description: source = output (right edge of block); target = input (left edge).

bus.description: Bus type per ADR-001 (../ADR-001-multi-bit-bus-types.md). Must be one of the 53 declared BusType values.

ports.description: Map of handle id -> {dir, bus}. Handle ids are kebab-case for audio/gate (audio-out, gate-out, mix-out, in-1, in-2) and short single-token names for VGA (r, g, b, hsync, vsync, visible, x, y, pixel, inside). CPU primitives use in-a / in-b / sum-out / carry-out etc.

type.description: JS type after JSON round-trip. `intArray` is for ROM contents (the only list-shaped parameter today).

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for `int` params; ignored for `string` and `intArray`.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for `int` params; ignored for `string` and `intArray`.

default.description: Default value for newly-spawned nodes. Mirrors Palette.defaultDataForType. For intArray, an array of 16 ints.

label.description: Visible 3-char-ish label shown next to the input on the block. Per the LD audit, prefer 3-char labels over single letters.

ariaLabel.description: Full-word label used by `aria-label` for screen readers (e.g. 'Attack milliseconds'). Always spelled out regardless of visible-label brevity.

unit.description: Suffix shown after the input (Hz, ms, etc.). Omit for unitless params.

enum.description: Allowed string values for `string`-type parameters (e.g. wavetable shape, solidcolor color).

backendParam.description: Python kwarg name passed to the Elaboratable's __init__. Omit if same as the manifest key (e.g. `bits` -> `bits`, no rename); set if different (e.g. `freq` -> `freq_hz`).

backendNeedsSampleRate.description: If true, synth.py's _build_params adds sample_rate=SAMPLE_RATE to the kwargs alongside this parameter. True for oscillators / ADSR / Gate / filters / FM / Wavetable.

parameters.description: Parameter map. Omit for parameterless blocks.

cssMinHeight.description: Pixel min-height for blocks with many handles (e.g. VgaTiming, ColorBars). null or omit to use the App.css default.

cssMinWidth.description: Pixel min-width for blocks wider than the default (e.g. ROM's textarea-bearing layout, ADSR/FM's multi-row parameter blocks). null or omit to use the default.

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering. Empty for shipped blocks; populated as the catalog evolves.
